issues.where: crop 5, left skyline behind the neighboring plants
issues.what: The star field stops at a ruler-straight line that abruptly joins the hills, and the smooth gray strip below makes the background look like a flat cutout.
issues.fix: Break up the straight skyline with distant terrain and vary the depth and density of the haze across the field.

issues.where: crops 2 and 4, raised folds of the large leaf at lower left
issues.what: Broad silver highlights roll over the folds without fine surface texture, making the leaf read as molded plastic beside the more convincing translucent green areas.
issues.fix: Break up the highlights with fine leaf texture and varied roughness, and soften the brightest peaks while preserving the transmitted green light.

issues.where: crops 5 and 6, neighboring plants across the middle distance
issues.what: Several neighboring plants repeat the same upright stem and paired drooping leaf silhouette at similar heights, exposing the instancing.
issues.fix: Vary the plants' height, tilt, leaf spacing and posture, especially along the upper silhouette of the field.
